employees.basis: workforce of 85,100 people, including the core Intel workforce and employees at Mobileye and other subsidiaries

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 People
source.quote: We invest in our highly skilled workforce, which was comprised of 85,100 1 people as of December 27, 2025 ... 1 Employee headcount includes our core Intel workforce as well as employees at Mobileye and other subsidiaries.

payroll.label: 2025 annual total compensation of our median compensated employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement, CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The 2025 annual total compensation of our CEO Mr. Tan is $93,244,700, the 2025 annual total compensation of our median compensated employee is $114,900, and the ratio of these amounts is 812 to 1.

notes: Employees: year-end head count from the FY2025 10-K. The 10-K says the 2025 Restructuring Plan cut the core Intel workforce by about 15% by the end of fiscal 2025 compared with the Q2 2025 head count. Payroll: the FY2025 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used.
